therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Graft-versus-leukemia effect mediated by donor T-cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immune-mediated elimination of residual cancer cells post-transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Post-transplant patients with hematologic malignancies (leukemia, lymphomas, multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndrome)

results.effect_size: 1-year survival: 20/42 (47.6%) at 0.5x10^8 dose vs 3/15 (20%) at 1.0x10^8 dose
subgroup_findings: Lower dose (0.5x10^8) showed better survival than higher dose (1.0x10^8)
Complete remission rates: 22/42 (52.4%) at lower dose vs 7/15 (46.7%) at higher dose
safety_signals: Acute GVHD: 10/15 (66.7%) at high dose vs 10/42 (23.8%) at low dose
Bone marrow aplasia: 1/42 at low dose
Infections and sepsis at high dose
results.dose_information: Two dose levels: 0.5x10^8 CD3+ T-cells/kg and 1.0x10^8 CD3+ T-cells/kg, infused over 2 hours

context.comparator: Dose comparison study (0.5 vs 1.0 x 10^8 CD3+ T-cells/kg)
